data.body: [P1] The catch is too late to guarantee deferred optional-dependency failure. Each caller constructs a typed lambda whose bootstrap signature references its optional SDK client class; JVM linkage can therefore throw `NoClassDefFoundError` during exporter `build()`, before `factory.get()` runs, bypassing plugin isolation. Keep optional types out of the lambda bootstrap via an erased or reflection-based factory, and test exporter construction through a classloader without the service JAR.
